steps.text: The PR reworks eval token budgets per model family. The old remaining-tokens line subtracted from a flat pool. I want to see whether that sign survived the move into the ledger.
Reading the diff on **#412 — Cap eval-run token budget per model family**.

The cap table is fine. The return is not: `remaining` adds `spent` to the cap. The line it replaces subtracted from a flat pool. A Haiku eval that has spent 90k now reports 170k left, and the new test only checks `>= 0`.
